name: com.faxvio/faxvio
title: Faxvio
description: Fax lookups: which countries a fax can go to, how to dial a number, page cost and transmission time.

tools.name: format_fax_number
tools.description: Turn a fax number as it is printed into international form, resolve which territory it belongs to, and say whether the Faxvio app will dial it and whether its prefix costs two pages per page. Handles the traps: a parenthesised (0), a leading 00 or 011, the shared dial codes, and the countries whose leading zero survives an international call.

country.description: The country the number belongs to, as a name, ISO2 code or dial code. Required when the number is written nationally, with no + and no international prefix.

tools.name: check_fax_destination
tools.description: Whether a fax can be sent to a country, its dial code, the fax carrier's support tier, and the local prefixes that cost two pages per page. Answers "can I fax to X".

country.description: Country name ("Japan"), ISO2 ("JP") or dial code ("+81").

tools.name: list_fax_destinations
tools.description: Every country and territory the Faxvio app will send a fax to, optionally filtered to one region.

region.description: One of: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Middle East & Africa.

tools.name: estimate_fax_cost
tools.description: Pages charged, the cheapest mix of packs that covers them and the total in US dollars. Pass the destination number or country and the doubling rule for toll-free, shared-cost and premium prefixes is applied for you.

pages.description: Pages in the document. The cover page is not charged.

country.description: Destination country, if the number is written nationally or unknown.

tools.name: estimate_fax_time
tools.description: How long a fax of N pages takes to send, from ITU-T T.4 page geometry and T.30 session overhead, with its range. Set voip when either end is on an internet line — it caps the modem rate.

content.description: What is on the page. Compression is the largest single factor.

bit_rate.description: Negotiated modem rate in bit/s, e.g. 9600, 14400, 33600.
